Prices exclude sales tax/VAT unless the entry says otherwise.

fitmentRules.boltPattern: Lug count x bolt-circle diameter in mm (e.g., 5x114.3). Must match the hub exactly; 5x112 and 5x114.3 are NOT interchangeable.
fitmentRules.offset: Distance in mm from the wheel's mounting face to its centerline. Positive = face toward the outside (typical FWD cars); negative = wheel pushed outward (typical off-road trucks). Wrong offset causes rubbing on suspension/fenders and changes scrub radius.
fitmentRules.centerBore: Wheel's center hole must equal or exceed the hub diameter; if larger, hub-centric rings center it. Too small = will not mount.
fitmentRules.otherChecks: Width and diameter vs. tire size and brake-caliper clearance; load rating; lug seat type (conical/ball/flat); TPMS sensor compatibility. Overall tire diameter change affects speedometer.
fitmentRules.modelSuggestion: A vehicle has {boltPattern, centerBoreMm, offsetRangeMm, maxWidthIn, diameterRangeIn}; a wheel fits only if boltPattern matches exactly, wheel centerBore >= hub, and offset/width fall within the vehicle's range.

ledHidConversions.rule: Aftermarket LED/HID bulbs in halogen headlamp housings do not comply with FMVSS 108; NHTSA says no LED replaceable headlamp bulb meets the standard and works with CBP to block imports, but leaves enforcement of owner modifications to states.
ledHidConversions.notes: Primary NHTSA interpretation letter not fetched.

ledHidConversions.rule: Converting a halogen headlamp to HID or LED is an MOT Major fail ('light source and lamp not compatible') for cars first used on/after 1986-04-01.
HID bulb in a non-HID headlamp is an NCT fail; HID must be a complete type-approved system with self-levelling and cleaning. Aftermarket LED bulbs are not explicitly addressed (per forums).

ledHidConversions.notes: No jurisdiction-specific primary text captured; federal (US) and CMVSS 108 (Canada) govern equipment.

underglow.rule: VTL 375(41) reserves blue (volunteer fire), green (volunteer ambulance) and amber (hazard vehicles) lights; red is for emergency vehicles. Secondary sources read this as: only white, steady (non-flashing) underglow is lawful.
Diffused lights permitted under VC 25400 below 0.05 candela per sq in; no red visible from front; not within 12 in of required lamps; max 720 sq in.

Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989: no red light to the front; blue reserved for emergency vehicles; no dazzling/distracting lamps. Secondary: underglow tolerated only if not red/blue, not flashing, not visible to front.
HTA s.62: only police vehicles may carry red-and-blue lamps casting to the front; flashing blue restricted to police/snow removal. No specific underglow provision.

exhaust.rule: VTL 375(31): muffler required; modifying exhaust to increase noise is prohibited. SLEEP Act (signed 2021-10-29, in force 2022-04-01) raised the fine to up to $1,000 and/or 30 days jail; shops violating more than twice (or willfully) in 18 months can lose their inspection license.
exhaust.notes: Per SEMA, inspectors do not carry decibel meters at inspection.

exhaust.rule: VC 27150/27151: aftermarket exhaust legal if <=95 dBA under SAE J1492 (vehicles <6,000 lb GVWR). Cited drivers can get a BAR Referee noise certificate.
MOT section 8.1: exhaust must not be noticeably louder than a standard silencer in average condition (tester judgment); emissions over limit fail; removing a DPF is illegal and an MOT fail.

US-CA-rule.rule: Since 2021-07-19 Smog Check scans the ECU; software not from the OEM or approved by a CARB Executive Order fails and the car cannot be registered. Aftermarket emissions-related parts need a CARB EO number.

insuranceDisclosure.rule: Consumer Insurance (Disclosure and Representations) Act 2012: consumer must take reasonable care not to misrepresent. Insurers ask about modifications; an undisclosed mod lets the insurer apply remedies according to whether the misrepresentation was innocent, careless or deliberate/reckless (from proportionate claim reduction up to avoiding the policy).
insuranceDisclosure.notes: No published per-modification premium loading exists; insurers price individually.

insuranceDisclosure.rule: Consumer Insurance Contracts Act 2019: no duty to volunteer information; the consumer must answer the insurer's specific questions honestly and with reasonable care. Ambiguous questions are read in the consumer's favor.

insuranceDisclosure.notes: Governed by policy terms and state/provincial misrepresentation law; not researched.

inspections.rule: 14 CFR 91.409(a): annual inspection every 12 calendar months for all aircraft, signed by an A&P with Inspection Authorization (IA). 91.409(b): additionally a 100-hour inspection if the aircraft carries passengers for hire or is provided by the instructor for flight instruction for hire. An annual can count as a 100-hour, not the reverse. The 100-hour limit may be overflown by up to 10 hours to reach an inspection place; the excess counts against the next interval. A 100-hour needs only an A&P.
inspections.notes: Rule text summarized from search results referencing eCFR; eCFR page not separately fetched. US-only; UK/IE (EASA/CAA Part-ML), Canada (CARs Standard 625) and Mexico differ and were not researched.
